items.passage: Transcript: Hi, this is Dario Whitcombe at Career Services. Normally, résumé reviews are walk-in, on Monday afternoons, in Room 352 of Tessly Hall. For the two weeks before the career fair, that changes. Seniors will need to call extension 6045 ahead of time and reserve a twenty-minute slot, because that's when seniors' demand is heaviest. Juniors and sophomores can still walk in, but on Wednesday mornings instead of Mondays. Alumni can keep uploading a résumé online and get written notes back within three days, same as always. One more thing. Room 352 is about the size of a closet. If someone's already with an adviser when you arrive, please wait on the benches out in the hallway rather than coming in. There are only two chairs, and the adviser needs both of them. And do bring a printed copy, since advisers mark up the page by hand.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Career services] How can seniors get a résumé review during the two weeks before the career fair?
choices: By calling ahead to reserve a set time
By walking in on a Monday afternoon
By walking in on a Wednesday morning
By uploading it online for written notes
items.correct_answer: By calling ahead to reserve a set time
items.explanation: The speaker says, "Seniors will need to call extension 6045 ahead of time and reserve a twenty-minute slot," so the answer is "By calling ahead to reserve a set time." "By walking in on a Monday afternoon" is the normal arrangement, which "changes" for these two weeks. "By walking in on a Wednesday morning" applies to "Juniors and sophomores," not seniors. "By uploading it online for written notes" is the arrangement for "Alumni."
